name: Hypnotic Pattern
summary: Charms and Incapacitates creatures that see a twisting pattern of colors.

stats.effect:
You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/cube} within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {ref:condition/charmed} condition for the duration. While {ref:condition/charmed}, the creature has the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition and a {ref:glossary/speed} of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
